First author Michael C. Mozer is a senior researcher who studied RNN vanishing gradients back in 1991. The paper demonstrates Gemini 3’s state-tracking failures using a number-guessing game and a bank ambiguity test, and uses the Patchscopes tool to reveal the root cause: the state-update result is buried too deep for subsequent shallow processing to access.
